$comment: FetchJAV <-> upstream ownership map. Read by scripts/sync_upstream.py. Classes: 'fetchjav_owned' (never auto-modified by upstream; reserved for files/features FetchJAV itself added or modified, NOT for inherited files it merely kept), 'upstream_owned' (safe to auto-adopt upstream when FetchJAV has not diverged), anything else => 'shared' (3-way merge with the fork base, conflicts reported for manual resolution). 'preserve' re-inserts FetchJAV-kept feature blocks that upstream removed from a shared file (block lines must match the fork base exactly; inserted before 'insert_before'). Patterns are fnmatch-style globs relative to the repo root.
